ck_bookings_customer_or_guest.name: ck_bookings_customer_or_guest
ck_bookings_customer_or_guest.value: "bookings"."customer_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("bookings"."guest_name" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."guest_phone" IS NOT NULL)

ck_users_identifier.name: ck_users_identifier
ck_users_identifier.value: "users"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."phone" IS NOT NULL

uq_notifications_dedupe_user.name: uq_notifications_dedupe_user
uq_notifications_dedupe_user.where: "notifications"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."dedupe_key" IS NOT NULL

uq_notifications_dedupe_email.name: uq_notifications_dedupe_email
uq_notifications_dedupe_email.where: "notifications"."user_id" IS NULL AND "notifications"."to_email" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."dedupe_key" IS NOT NULL

ck_payments_single_payable.name: ck_payments_single_payable
ck_payments_single_payable.value: (("payments"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer + ("payments"."event_registration_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer + ("payments"."tournament_registration_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer + ("payments"."cafe_invoice_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer) = 1

ck_promo_redemptions_single_target.name: ck_promo_redemptions_single_target
ck_promo_redemptions_single_target.value: (("promo_redemptions"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer + ("promo_redemptions"."event_registration_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer + ("promo_redemptions"."tournament_registration_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer) = 1

ck_promos_value.name: ck_promos_value

ck_promos_code_or_auto.name: ck_promos_code_or_auto
ck_promos_code_or_auto.value: ("promos"."code" IS NOT NULL AND "promos"."is_auto" = false) OR ("promos"."code" IS NULL AND "promos"."is_auto" = true)

ck_slot_claims_single_owner.name: ck_slot_claims_single_owner
ck_slot_claims_single_owner.value: (("slot_claims"."booking_item_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer + ("slot_claims"."court_maintenance_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer) = 1

ck_slot_claims_owner_matches_type.name: ck_slot_claims_owner_matches_type
ck_slot_claims_owner_matches_type.value: ("slot_claims"."claim_type" = 'booking' AND "slot_claims"."booking_item_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("slot_claims"."claim_type" = 'maintenance' AND "slot_claims"."court_maintenance_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_slot_claims_hold_expiry.name: ck_slot_claims_hold_expiry
ck_slot_claims_hold_expiry.value: ("slot_claims"."status" = 'held' AND "slot_claims"."hold_expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("slot_claims"."status" <> 'held' AND "slot_claims"."hold_expires_at" IS NULL)

ck_price_rules_scope.name: ck_price_rules_scope
ck_price_rules_scope.value: "price_rules"."court_id" IS NOT NULL OR "price_rules"."sport_id" IS NOT NULL
